title: Copying a Page

readiness.reading: copying words letter by letter, from their sounds (older: without letters shown)

intro.speaker: elias
intro.text: Long ago, before there were printing presses, monks copied every book by hand, letter by letter.

intro.speaker: elias
intro.text: This page needs its words. Listen to each one, and set the letters in their places, as carefully as you can.

steps.speaker: elias
steps.prompt: Listen to the word. Which sounds do you hear? Put each letter in its place.

older.prompt: Listen to the word. Which sounds do you hear, first to last? Find each letter in the box.

feedback.wrong: Listen again: {word}. That sound goes somewhere else.
feedback.all_good: A whole page, copied with care!

outro.speaker: elias
outro.text: Every word copied is a word kept for the children who come after us. Thank you, little scribe.

journal_line: At the monastery, I copied a page of words with Brother Elias.
unavailable_text: The page is copied for today.
